text: Based on the evidence, no trees were cut down on this property after 2020. The assessment indicates that no tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or more were detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The data sources used include the Hansen Global Forest Change dataset, the JRC Global Forest Cover 2020, and the MGAP 2021 national forest cartography. The observations show that there was no forest cover in 2020 and no significant tree cover changes were observed in the subsequent years. Therefore, it can be concluded that no trees were cut down on this property after 2020.
